result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. Your example comes out as T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1. I didn't add a test for that example. The existing tests pass (`mvn -q -o test`), but I didn't check whether any of them covers the region ticket order.

The change is in `DataStore.findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion`, in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. It now uses the same `.highestPriorityFirst()` ordering as the sales rep's open-ticket list, and I updated its Javadoc to match. Closed tickets and other regions' tickets are filtered out as before.

The only caller of this method is `RegionManagerService`, so nothing else changes order.
